turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let me show you one first.
I see "egg". It starts with the sound "e". So I write: I have an egg.
Rule: say a before a consonant sound, and an before a vowel sound.
Right: I have a cat.
Wrong: I have an cat.

Now you try. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
